about: Maps Driftfall things to image files. Paths are relative to this file (assets/sprites/). All sprites are 64x64 PNG with transparency unless noted; the ground tile is opaque. Side 0 is cobalt blue, side 1 is ember orange, matching TEAM_COLORS. Licenses: see ../LICENSES.md (all CC0, Kenney).

structures.note: Structures are neutral grey with small accent colour; tint or add a side-colour ring/plate yourself.

effects.note: Particle images are 512x512 white/grey-scale style blobs; scale down and tint with globalCompositeOperation or a coloured fill. Extra variants live in kenney-particles/PNG (Transparent)/.

ui.bars: ../ui/kenney-ui-space/PNG/Blue/Default/ (bar_square_*, bar_round_*; _l/_m/_r are left, middle, right slices)

alternatives.pack: kenney-scifi-rts/PNG/Default size/ (Unit 01-12 blue, 13-24 orange, 25-36 green, 37-48 grey; Structure 01-16; Environment 01-20; Tile 01-42)
